frozen_core_outcome.condition: D01 PASS and D02 PASS and D03 PASS
frozen_core_outcome.downstream: Proceed with the planned outcome-blind TARGET representation benchmark and subsequent frozen stability/biology pipeline, subject to all other frozen gates.
frozen_core_outcome.interpretation: The frozen gate meets the preregistered core specificity and standard-operating-point sensitivity criteria in the final simulation bank.

frozen_narrow_gate_failure_policy.D04_ROTATIONAL_SUBSPACE: If failed, do not claim reliable recovery of rotationally ambiguous subspaces; individual-factor claims remain forbidden as already specified.
frozen_narrow_gate_failure_policy.D05_VIEW_SUPPORT: If failed, view-support labels remain exploratory and cannot support primary shared-versus-partial claims.
frozen_narrow_gate_failure_policy.D06_BATCH_SPECIFICITY: If failed, stable factors cannot be assumed biological without external recurrence; technical-confound limitations become a primary conclusion rather than a hidden caveat.
frozen_narrow_gate_failure_policy.D07_NO_POSTHOC_RETUNING: Any alternative threshold explored after results is explicitly exploratory and cannot replace the primary frozen gate.

outcome_boundary: Outcomes are not opened to rescue a failed core representation/gate validation. Outcome analysis, if reached, is a minimal downstream validation of a representation already frozen without outcomes.
stress_subgroup_rule: A favorable pooled D01 result may not suppress poor prespecified subgroup behavior. Per-n and null-mechanism results are mandatory descriptive reporting, but they do not create new post-hoc PASS/FAIL thresholds.
